scope: Private owner-bound local settings, existing autosave lifecycle, explicit-hour relocation proposals and validation; actual task moves and cross-device preference synchronization remain unconnected.

storage.protectedPlatformStore: Existing chunked SecureVault backed by device-only Keychain / Android Keystore protection
storage.sqlite: Existing account-bound no-backup database writer lock. No plaintext preference contents in SQL.
storage.writes: Observed revision CAS, idempotent duplicate saves, recover a published protected value after a lost response without replaying a write.
storage.network: No preference transport, Google authorization or group operation on settings read/save.

iphone.input: Real XCTest text input in the normal shared component
iphone.cold: Stopped the LiFlow process and relaunched without resetting data; both original text values and protected store verified.

android.input: Real ADB tap and keyboard input. Stored result verified by QA guard and screenshot. No total input duration claimed.
android.cold: Stopped the LiFlow process and relaunched; initial QA link assertion timed out at 30.176s, then reopened the route in the same new process without modifying the fields.

regressions: Unset or incomplete times never imply all-day permission.
DST gap/fold boundaries require review, while explicit complete days span their actual 23/25 hours.
Keep the original chore region and civil window when allowed bands use another region.
Reject invalid intervals, unknown group kinds, string authority flags and unrelated range fields before movement.
One accepted revision for 100 identical saves; independent SQLite writers detect conflicting edits.
Preserve newer incomplete drafts and block back/navigation until saved or explicitly discarded.
Reject foreign/malformed/oversized profiles and account changes after asynchronous protected access.
Use saved owner preferences in the normal v2 route without changing shared plan/hash/outbox.
Invalid initial defaults are reported before constructing the editor.
retainedFailures: phase4ax-relocation-red.log: three actual invalid-input regressions failed before the strict guards.
Initial Native fixture failures required explicitly binding the new actual preference-store module, not weakening permission checks.
The first new route assertion used a development-only heading; corrected to the actual normal-workspace heading/ready state.
Android accessibility scroll/property edits did not establish real screen/storage behavior; actual ADB gestures and keyboard input did.
The temporary helper initially treated a multi-command string as a shell script; switched to separate commands.
The final Android cold QA link did not arrive before the view assertion timeout; the protected data passed on reopening the route in that new process.
limits: Both devices independently entered synthetic settings. This is not cross-device preference sync.
No personal task relocation is persisted, no relocation history is connected yet.
Cold QA-link retry does not establish all production cold deep links or Widget navigation.
No app reset or replacement installation in this phase. SDK native builds remain 58.0.21.
No production Rules deployment, real-group migration, main merge, README overwrite or global product UI polish.
